primary: DDI0602 ID032025, printed page1412, PDF page1415
selection: Existing RAX policy: config.version >= ArmVersion::V9_4A. This is not a claim that every Arm v9.4 CPU implements the feature.
scope: Preserve existing structural admission and move the existing version gate before FP access and native optimization. No general FP8 arithmetic or FPMR qualification.

remaining.finding: Existing FP8 execution uses a fixed E5M2-like widening path with intermediate multiply/add rounding; current primary semantics use FPMR-controlled source formats, scaling and fused accumulation.
Existing executor uses a four-bit source register and omits Rm[3] from the element index. The primary defines Vm in0..7 and index=H:L:M:Rm[3]. These data semantics remain unresolved.
